thesis: A neural model is inspectable arithmetic over numeric representations, but choosing and preparing those representations is substantive work.
role: Replace mystification with tensors, reproducible preparation and careful interpretation of importance.

ideas.statement: Artificial neurons compute weighted sums and activations rather than biological rhythms, chemical changes and continuous learning.
Cleaning, encoding, scaling and feature engineering must form a pipeline fitted on training data alone.
Tensor shapes and matrix multiplication explain storage, forward computation and GPU parallelism; quantization trades numeric precision for space.
Feature importance reports reliance, not causation, and correlated features can split or conceal their apparent importance.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Numbering countries invents a false numeric order; one-hot encoding avoids that implication.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Readable weights or attention patterns do not automatically yield a complete explanation.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
